scenario.title: Chalk monsters
scenario.description: Grimy balls lose speed and grab at contact.

curriculum.lesson: Dirty ball surfaces transfer speed and spin differently at impact. Compare a fuller contact with the thinner cut and include the distance left for the object ball. In the result, compare clean and dirty contact responses at matched arrival conditions: inspect outgoing speed separately from outgoing direction. The grime remains part of every scored trial.
curriculum.takeaway: When contacts are less clean, compare cut angle and remaining potting distance together.

briefing.gotcha: An open pocket does not guarantee clean transfer. Dirt affects the collision as well as rolling speed.

conditions.name: Dirty balls
conditions.description: Chalk and grime add drag, reduce collision bounce and increase friction between balls.
